caption: The drawing depicts an oval-shaped plaque with a raised relief of a tree in its center. The tree has a thick trunk and dense foliage, with leaves extending outward in multiple clusters from several main branches, creating a broad canopy. The visual texture of the plaque suggests a coarse, stone-like or metal material, shaded in varying tones of gray to render depth and three-dimensionality. The plaque has two small, circular holes: one located at the top and one at the bottom of the oval. The background behind the plaque is a plain, light, off-white surface without ornamentation. The artist’s signature appears in small letters in the lower left corner outside the oval.
title: Firemark
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
